dogecoin.text: @Crypt0Prophets @Forbes A group of supporters has raised more than $25,000 in the internet currency Dogecoin to let the Jamaican bobsleigh team attend the Winter Olympics in Sochi. On Sunday, news broke that the team had qualified for the Winter Olympics for the first time since 2002.
